release_notes: Build 86 fixes the Quiz History archive-action visibility bug by recognising the page's Border-wrapped Grid layout.
Match archive and Archive selected now appear reliably in the Quiz History footer before Delete.
Match archive still updates Quiz History paths only and never moves, renames, overwrites or deletes archive files.
Archive selected still uses the safe copy, verify, Quiz History update and local cleanup workflow and only allows fully-uploaded quizzes.
Build 85 adds conservative one-to-one matching for existing quiz folders in the configured archive.
Build 84 adds manual archiving for already-completed quizzes without requiring a re-upload.
Build 83 changes Full and Marathon quizzes to a 5-second default and adds automatic post-upload archiving.
Build 82 fixes the Questions importer UI and Build 81 adds Open Trivia DB JSON importing with preview, category mapping and duplicate handling.
